digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter value maps (Cloud and DataCenter)
propositions: Ticket-type mapping is duplicated across Cloud (outbound_fields.py:88) and DataCenter (backend.py:43) adapters, creating risk of silent divergence at creation time
Existing one-literal guard tests protect STATUS and PRIORITY maps but do not cover TICKET-TYPE map, leaving the duplication undetected by CI
Two existing copies are content-identical (same four keys and values, differing only in dict literal order), making unification behavior-preserving for both deployments
Canonical single definition must be relocated to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported as private alias _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE in both create paths to preserve module-attribute accessibility
Build guard must fail when a second type-map literal is reintroduced, using AST analysis matching the existing status and priority guards
Type mapping values must be pinned by value for all four local types (task/story/bug/epic) through both Cloud and DataCenter create paths
